evidence: RUNTIME FACT LIST (skill quality-checks.md #4) vs where stated: (1) entry/path: instruction.md:13 'Put the application in /app' and 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'starts from /app/server.js'. test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js; test.sh:97-111 launches node $APP_ENTRY. (2) port: instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5 'port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; test.sh:108 PORT=3000, probes 127.0.0.1:3000; app_context.md URL http://localhost:3000. (3) storage: instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; test.sh:98-109 passes DB_PATH=/app/app.db or $APP_COPY/app.db when /app is not writable, and that copy/cwd/unprivileged behaviour is disclosed in hireops_rules.md:197-201 ('may launch a writable copy', 'Resolve bundled UI and seed files relative to the entry', 'Honor the supplied DB_PATH', launch env PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH). (4) health: instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10; test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /. (5) seed: instruction.md:13,15 '/assets/seed_data.json', load once, no shipped DB, '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime' so copy into /app; hireops_rules.md:205-208 explains read-marker semantics, candidate wording and page size 30 (both present in seed keys candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size). (6) accounts: instruction.md:17 password Hireops!2026 and all 10 emails with roles; these exactly match seed users and app_context.md:8-19 (seed carries no passwords, so stating it is necessary and done). (7) fixed clock: none needed — no criterion depends on 'today', ages or deadlines (grep of tests for clock/today/due/overdue/date found nothing time-based; seed created_at only orders history); recording as not applicable rather than missing. (8) deps/delivery: instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 Express + better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH; integration.md:16-19 symlink rule matches test.sh:72-83 rejection of links outside /app/node_modules. (9) network public: instruction.md:13 'browser side is free to pull fonts or a script from a CDN' consistent with profile; no offline constraint needed. COVERAGE (graded -> asked): walked all 2 gate, 42 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria. 'note is not a change' and undo-once -> rules:96-100; hro_activity (newest first, job filter, reason, notes excluded) and refusals -> rules:110-113; hro_notes -> rules:104-106; hro_live_board 15 s -> instruction.md:5, rules:117-119; hro_msg_* (Enter/Shift+Enter, blank refused, box empty and focused) -> rules:138-140; hro_thread_latest/earlier (30, remaining count) -> rules:144-147; hro_unread_counts per person/total, Lena starts at 1 -> rules:151-154 + seed reads (USR-CAN3 read_count 2 of 3 messages, third from USR-REC3 => 1 unread, derivable from rules:206-207); hro_unread_scrolled_up -> rules:156-160; hro_seen incl. observer never counts -> rules:164-166; hro_thread_access -> rules:131-134; hro_drafts and polish session_resume/other-user isolation -> instruction.md:7, rules:170-175; note draft survives reload (polish failed_send, session_resume) -> rules:105-106 'kept for that person on that browser'; failed send keeps text and explains -> rules:140; live update preserving typing/focus/open card/scroll (polish live_board/live_thread) -> instruction.md:5, rules:121-123; earlier-page anchor (polish earlier_place) -> rules:145-147; hro_candidate_view wording -> rules:182-189; hro_candidate_private (no notes/reason/rejected-from/place/others/activity; not-found for another application) -> instruction.md:9, rules:22-23,191-193; hro_candidate_linked -> rules:34-36; hro_restart -> instruction.md:15, integration.md:8-9. Visual rows grade craft of the requested Board/Conversations/Activity/candidate views, a professional default under instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters'; no theme or phone layout is graded, matching 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'. Gate sign-in is both requested (instruction.md:9,17) and the house convention. No graded item lacks a public requirement. ATTEMPTED COUNTEREXAMPLES: (a) Broken app that could pass: one that reads /assets/seed_data.json at runtime or ignores DB_PATH could still pass if the verifier happens to provide /assets (test.sh:88 chmods it if present) and /app is writable (DB_PATH then equals /app/app.db) — this is grader leniency, not an unstated requirement, so not a row-4 defect. (b) Conforming alternative that could fail: an app whose staff card-detail endpoint is role-filtered and returns a candidate's own application without private fields; K protocol/hro_candidate_private say that replay must be 'refused'. Rules:193 does say 'The board ... and every staff action are refused to candidates', and the fail clause is leak-based ('Fails if any of that data or existence leaks'), so this is publicly grounded; recorded as a minor observation only. (c) Protocol R says 'confirm no move, add or note control is offered' for Aud/Tomas, but the scoring criterion hro_observer_readonly explicitly makes control visibility the app's choice; no grade depends on it. (d) hro_job_open's blank-title refusal is implied by rules:27 'A job has a title' rather than stated literally; a reasonable professional default. None of (a)-(d) is a confirmed defect for this row. Scope note: this is a source/instruction review; the mechanical string agreement belongs to the deterministic reviewer (check-runtime-contract-strings.py), and no runtime measurement is required to judge this row.
